title: 変化球のしくみ ― 使い方と見どころ（ホップの正体・ナックル・打者の0.1秒）
description:
ボールの速さ・向き・回転から、重力・空気の抵抗・回転の力を1ミリ秒ごとに計算して道すじを解くブラウザのアプリ「変化球のしくみ」の、使い方と見どころです。球種の名前で曲がり方を決めず、力の計算だけで、フォーシームが「落ちにくい」わけや、ナックルの行き先が読めないわけを見ます。計算と見せ方を試す技術検証で、選手の指導や評価には使えません。

0:00 はじめに（カメラと時間のつまみ）
0:20 もし空気がなかったら
0:30 フォーシームと「ホップ」の正体
0:44 空気の流れの断面
0:56 スライダーと「使える回転」
1:10 ナックルと10球のばらつき
1:26 打者の目（決める時刻）
1:44 空気と風（高地・向かい風）
1:58 自由に試す

アプリ（ブラウザで動きます。パソコン・スマホ）:
https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/pitch-physics/

しし屋 まなびラボ（ほかのアプリ）:
https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/

おもな出どころ:
Nathan AM, Trajectory Calculator（ボールの飛び方の計算機。空気の抵抗・揚力の係数）
Watts RG, Sawyer E (1975) Aerodynamics of a knuckleball. American Journal of Physics 43:960–963
Nathan AM (2012) Analysis of knuckleball trajectories. Procedia Engineering 34:116–121
Morrissey MP (2009) The aerodynamics of the knuckleball pitch. MS Thesis, Marquette University
Nathan AM (2023) What is the Hawkeye spin data teaching us? III: Searching for the seam-shifted wake
Nakashima H ほか (2025) Frontiers in Sports and Active Living 7（スイングの時間）
Bahill AT, LaRitz T (1984) American Scientist 72:249–253（目で追える速さ）
投手の例は、よくある投げ方を表した架空の例です。

音楽: プログラムで合成したオリジナルの音です。

#変化球 #野球 #物理 #まなびラボ

en.title: How Pitches Break ― App Guide: Why Fastballs "Rise", Knuckleballs and the Batter's 0.1 s
en.description:
A guide to "How Pitches Break", a browser app that solves a pitch's path by computing gravity, air drag and the spin force every millisecond from its speed, direction and spin. The break is never set from the pitch name: the forces alone show why a four-seam fastball "drops less" and why nobody can predict a knuckleball. It is a tech demo for testing the calculation and visuals, not for coaching or evaluating players. Turn on English subtitles (CC).

0:00 Intro (cameras and the time slider)
0:20 If there were no air
0:30 The four-seam and the "rising fastball"
0:44 The airflow cross-section
0:56 The slider and "useful spin"
1:10 The knuckleball and 10 scattered pitches
1:26 The batter's eye (the decision moment)
1:44 Air and wind (altitude, headwind)
1:58 Try it yourself

Try the app (runs in your browser, PC or phone; switch the app to English with the EN button):
https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/pitch-physics/

Shishiya Manabi Lab (more apps):
https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/

Main sources:
Nathan AM, Trajectory Calculator (drag and lift coefficients)
Watts RG, Sawyer E (1975) Aerodynamics of a knuckleball. American Journal of Physics 43:960–963
Nathan AM (2012) Analysis of knuckleball trajectories. Procedia Engineering 34:116–121
Morrissey MP (2009) The aerodynamics of the knuckleball pitch. MS Thesis, Marquette University
Nathan AM (2023) What is the Hawkeye spin data teaching us? III: Searching for the seam-shifted wake
Nakashima H et al. (2025) Frontiers in Sports and Active Living 7 (swing timing)
Bahill AT, LaRitz T (1984) American Scientist 72:249–253 (eye-tracking limit)
The pitcher examples are fictional, representing common styles.

Music: original sounds synthesized by code.

#Baseball #Physics #Pitching
